request.spec:
A year entry and a button generate the four calendar quarters of that year as periods named
<yyyy>-Q1 to <yyyy>-Q4, each as the period form would add it (a quarter that exists or overlaps is
left out); show how many were made.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A year entry and a button generate the four calendar quarters of that year as periods named
<yyyy>-Q1 to <yyyy>-Q4, each as the period form would add it (a quarter that exists or overlaps is
left out); show how many were made.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The quarterly periods feature is in and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 acceptance tests.

Enter a year and press "Generate quarters" to create four periods, `<yyyy>-Q1` to `<yyyy>-Q4`, covering January–March, April–June, July–September and October–December. The count made appears in the same place as the monthly and fiscal-year generates.

- **Skipped quarters:** as with the period form, a quarter whose name is already used or whose dates overlap an existing period is left out. Running it twice for the same year makes 0 the second time.
- **Bad year:** anything that isn't four digits is refused with an error, and nothing is saved or written to the audit file.
- **Audit:** each period made gets the same `PERIOD_ADDED` line as one added through the form.

The new endpoint is `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/periods/generate-quarters`, built the same way as the existing fiscal-year generate. The new Java steps are `ValidateGenerateQuarters` and `GenerateQuarters`, and the year box and button were added to `src/main/frontend/features/periods/list.slot.tsx`.
